meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 你给它一份资料（目录、网址、笔记或刚才的对话），它会从中提炼出可重复的步骤和注意事项，生成或更新一个技能文件（SKILL.md），之后你就能随时调用这个技能。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”“learn this”等关键词，或要求把目录、网址、笔记等来源变成技能、更新已有技能时触发。

say.text: 把咱们刚才一起做的流程变成一个技能
say.note: 它会梳理对话，生成可复用的技能。
它会抓取这个网页并生成技能。

say.text: 更新一下“打包发布”技能，加入这次的教训
say.note: 它会在原技能上补充注意事项。

howto.what_en: Given a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the conversation just completed, Claude distills a repeatable procedure with gotchas and writes or updates .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, so the workflow can be reused on demand.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', or similar phrases, or asks to turn a folder, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation into a skill, or to update an existing skill.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did into a skill.
say_en.note: Re-reads the conversation and writes a SKILL.md.
Fetches and distills the page into a skill.

say_en.text: Update the 'package-release' skill with today's lesson.
say_en.note: Refines the existing skill in place.
